name: Madhu Pandey
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, uses a walking stick for outdoor walks; IADLs managed with daughter's help.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw normal) – below threshold, plan for detailed cognitive assessment.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady with stick; timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk, advise strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 12 regular – polypharmacy, request review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies anhedonia or suicidal thoughts.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay active enough to attend my granddaughter's school events."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD; bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD; spironolactone 25 mg OD; furosemide 40 mg OD; dapagliflozin 10 mg OD; salbutamol MDI SOS; budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD; montelukast 10 mg HS; metformin 500 mg BD; glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast; sitagliptin 100 mg OD; empagliflozin 10 mg OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Echocardiogram: LVEF 40%, NYHA class II.
Serum potassium: 4.5 mmol/L (ref 3.5-5.0).
Serum creatinine: 1.2 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.2).
NT‑proBNP: 800 pg/mL (ref <400).
HbA1c: 7.8% (ref 4.0‑5.6%).
Fasting plasma glucose: 155 mg/dL (ref 70‑100).
Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio: 35 mg/g (ref <30).
Spirometry: FEV1 78% predicted; post‑bronchodilator 85% – positive reversibility.
Asthma Control Test: 18/25.
Dilated fundus exam: mild non‑proliferative diabetic retinopathy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent in ADLs; reports mild ankle swelling after long walks, uses stick less often.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal) – still below cutoff, neuropsychology referral pending.
falls: One fall at home slipping on wet floor 3 months ago, no injury; gait slightly unsteady; timed up‑and‑go 14 seconds – raised fall risk, prescribe physiotherapy and non‑slip socks.
medicines: 12 regular – polypharmacy, continue Beers review.
mood: Describes feeling more energetic after diuretic adjustment, denies depression.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I wish to walk to the market without stopping to rest."
